project.name: premarket-india-report
project.description: A zero dependency pre-market report site for Indian indices: a role based framework over four morning checks, an adaptive TimesFM plus LSTM ensemble, a 50 symbol self improving GBM ecosystem, a news and events layer, and 95 term plain language documentation. Deployed on Netlify free tier with 4 cron schedules.

nodes.name: Custom 404 page
nodes.summary: Branded error page showing the missing URL (filled in by chrome.js) with recovery links to today's report, the glossary and the methodology.

nodes.name: Compliance ledger
nodes.summary: The point by point audit ledger against the original spec document, version by version (v1 through v5.4), including what is deliberately honest versus what is out of scope.

nodes.name: Project README
nodes.summary: The project manual: what runs every trading day, the LSTM model provenance, TimesFM and the ensemble, the per stock ecosystem, the glossary and ELI5 pages, operations and the v5.4 changelog.

nodes.name: ELI5 page
nodes.summary: The whole site explained in the simplest possible words, for someone who has never traded. Every jargon word links to the glossary. Works fully without JavaScript.

nodes.name: Glossary page
nodes.summary: All 95 terms used anywhere on the site, each with a formal definition and a plain words line, cross linked. Searchable and filterable by category; an A to Z letter index jumps to entries. Rendered client side from glossary-terms.mjs.

nodes.name: Dashboard page
nodes.summary: The daily report page and the site front door. Renders the plain words summary, the framework bias call, indicator checks, market context, the adaptive ensemble forecast with charts, the TimesFM second opinion, the news and events panel, the HPQ validation exhibit and the report archive. All data comes from /api/latest at runtime; app.js drives it.

nodes.name: LLM instructions file
nodes.summary: Guides AI systems and crawlers: what the site is, the page map, the honest accuracy numbers and the data sources.

nodes.name: Methodology page
nodes.summary: How the report is built: every check, the role based framework steps, data sources with their exact endpoints, interpretation thresholds, the 4 daily schedules and a 6 question FAQ. The trust center of the site.

nodes.name: Models page
nodes.summary: Deep documentation of the LSTM (architecture, training data, validation against the DataCamp article), TimesFM 2.5, the adaptive ensemble and the per stock ecosystem. Honest limitations section. Static content plus one chart exhibit.

nodes.name: Netlify configuration
nodes.summary: Deploy config: publish dir, functions dir, esbuild bundler, the 4 cron schedules (news 03:10, daily 03:30, stocks 03:40, post-open 03:50 UTC) and the global security headers (CSP with the Netlify HUD hash, HSTS, XFO, XCTO, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, COOP) plus asset cache rules.

nodes.name: Package manifest
nodes.summary: Dev-only dependencies (netlify-cli, playwright) and the test script; the site itself ships zero npm dependencies.

nodes.name: Privacy page
nodes.summary: Plain language privacy policy: no accounts, no tracking, one localStorage key for the theme preference, data ownership of the upstream providers.

nodes.name: Robots file
nodes.summary: Allows all crawlers, points to the sitemap.

nodes.name: Site search page
nodes.summary: One search box over every page and all 95 glossary terms. The 102 document index (search-index.json) is fetched once and searched locally in the browser; nothing is transmitted.

nodes.name: Sitemap
nodes.summary: All 9 pages with change frequencies and priorities.

nodes.name: Skills lockfile
nodes.summary: Records the agent skills installed into .claude/skills (find-skills, web-design-guidelines, the Understand-Anything suite) for reproducibility.

nodes.name: Stocks page
nodes.summary: Live adaptive forecasts for 50 symbols (US mega caps, sector leaders, ETFs, global and Indian ADRs). The live table sorts on every column, filters by region and search; collapsed sections hold the decade backtest and the offline TimesFM artifact table. Fetches /api/stocks and /api/news.

nodes.name: Decade backtest data
nodes.summary: Walk-forward direction accuracy by year (2018 to 2026) for the per stock GBM ecosystem; rendered by the collapsed backtest section on the stocks page.

nodes.name: HPQ validation data
nodes.summary: The article's own HPQ dataset and training history used to prove the LSTM port reproduces the published result; drives the validation exhibit on the dashboard.

nodes.name: TimesFM model analysis
nodes.summary: Offline TimesFM 2.5 forecasts for NIFTY with the ensemble analysis; drives the second opinion panel and part of the model page.

nodes.name: Site search index
nodes.summary: 102 documents (7 pages plus 95 glossary terms with anchors) with plain text extracted at build time by tools/build-search-index.mjs. Consumed by search.html.

nodes.name: Offline TimesFM stock forecasts
nodes.summary: The offline per stock TimesFM artifact (5 session paths and per symbol backtest stats) rendered as the second table on the stocks page; blended into live forecasts while fresh.

nodes.name: Stock history seed
nodes.summary: Seed close history used to bootstrap per stock state before the adaptive cycle accumulates its own data.

nodes.name: Design system
nodes.summary: The single stylesheet: token block (spacing scale, 3 radius values, type scale, light and dark palettes, layered shadows, Okabe-Ito chart colors), base elements, header/nav, panels, tables, chips, skeletons, print rules and the Netlify badge hide.

nodes.name: Dashboard controller
nodes.summary: The dashboard brain: theme handling, report loading and rendering (bias, checks, context, prediction, news panel, archive), glossary term auto linking, the copy report button and the run scan button. Imports chart builders and the linkable glossary terms.

nodes.name: Chart builders
nodes.summary: Dependency free SVG chart builders: lineChart (multi series with axes and legend), sparkline (tiny inline series) and breadthBar (advance decline bar). Pure functions returning SVG markup.

nodes.name: Shared page chrome
nodes.summary: Theme toggle with persistence and prefers-color-scheme, scroll progress bar, header shadow, back to top button, mobile nav disclosure and the 404 missing path fill. Loaded by every page except the dashboard (app.js owns its own chrome).

nodes.name: Glossary term data
nodes.summary: The 95 term dataset (id, term, short definition, plain words line, category, cross links) plus LINKABLE, the map of phrases that pages auto link to glossary anchors.

nodes.name: Glossary viewer
nodes.summary: Renders the term list with search, category filters, the A to Z index and anchored entries; highlights search matches and flashes deep linked entries.

nodes.name: Site search viewer
nodes.summary: Fetches search-index.json, matches every whitespace separated term, ranks by hit count, renders up to 20 results with snippets and an aria-live result count. Focuses the box on fine pointer devices only.

nodes.name: Stocks page viewer
nodes.summary: Renders the live adaptive table (sortable columns, region filter chips, search), the events and news column with earnings chips, the decade backtest section and the offline TimesFM table. Binds all interactions.

nodes.name: Adaptive ensemble
nodes.summary: The NIFTY primary forecast: TimesFM artifact loading, artifact freshness, next trading day math, the learned weight blend w*TF+(1-w)*(LSTM-bias), the framework scorecard persistence and daily weight relearning from resolved outcomes.

nodes.name: GBM tree model
nodes.summary: The LightGBM dump_model export (trees, thresholds, leaf values) for the pooled direction model; evaluated in JS by gbmPredict with full precision thresholds.

nodes.name: LSTM runtime
nodes.summary: A faithful JavaScript port of the TensorFlow 1.6 LSTMCell math (3 stacked layers, 200/200/150 units) with a decoder for the base64 packed weights and a 5 session recursive forecaster. Runs in Node functions and could run in the browser.

nodes.name: Packed NIFTY model
nodes.summary: The trained NIFTY LSTM weights shipped as a base64 blob (~693k float32 parameters) plus the frozen scaler window; decoded once per cold start.

nodes.name: News and events engine
nodes.summary: The 08:40 IST cycle: CNBC and Google News RSS fetching and regex parsing, per symbol feeds with pacing, the Nasdaq earnings calendar (10 weekdays), keyword event tags, heavy news detection against a trailing 14 day average and the news-history blob accounting.

nodes.name: Pre-market scan engine
nodes.summary: The heart of the daily report: IST clock helpers, the four source checks (US indices, India VIX, NIFTY breadth, GIFT Nifty), market context (oil, gold, rates, FX, Asia), the role based framework v2 verdict, LSTM forecast integration and the markdown/HTML serialization of the report.

nodes.name: Stock feature math
nodes.summary: Feature engineering for the per stock models: date bisect, percent change, population std, RSI-14, the 26 feature row builder, the walk-forward splitter and the exported GBM tree prediction (dump_model port from LightGBM).

nodes.name: Per stock adaptive engine
nodes.summary: The 50 symbol ecosystem: STOCKS list, incremental Nasdaq history pulls, per stock state (bias, band, blend weight), prediction resolution against real closes, daily relearning, the calibrated 80 percent band and the stocks-live view assembly.

nodes.name: api-history endpoint
nodes.summary: GET /api/history: lists every saved report date from the reports/ blob prefix for the archive UI.

nodes.name: api-latest endpoint
nodes.summary: GET /api/latest: serves the stored latest report JSON from blobs (no-store) with a small in-memory cache.

nodes.name: api-news endpoint
nodes.summary: GET /api/news: serves the latest news cycle view (market and India headlines, per symbol feeds, earnings, tags, heavy flags).

nodes.name: api-report endpoint
nodes.summary: GET /api/report?date=YYYY-MM-DD: serves one archived report (JSON, markdown or HTML by extension).

nodes.name: api-scan endpoint
nodes.summary: POST /api/scan: the run-scan-now button behind the 2 minute blob throttle; forwards to scan-background with the manual trigger header.

nodes.name: api-stocks endpoint
nodes.summary: GET /api/stocks: serves the stocks-live view (50 predictions, per stock learning state, aggregate stats, artifact freshness).

nodes.name: daily-scan stub
nodes.summary: Scheduled 03:30 UTC (09:00 IST, Mon-Fri). Hands the full scan to scan-background with the daily-schedule trigger header; scheduled functions have a 30s cap so the work must move to a background function.

nodes.name: news-background worker
nodes.summary: Runs the full news cycle (market + India headlines, 50 per symbol feeds, earnings calendar). Public invocations are throttled to one run per 30 minutes by the last-news-run blob guard; scheduled runs always pass.

nodes.name: runScan
nodes.summary: Fetches all four checks plus context, applies the role framework, attaches the LSTM forecast and returns the full report object.

nodes.name: istNow
nodes.summary: IST clock: current date, time, weekend flag and session awareness for the scheduler and the report.

nodes.name: usIndices
nodes.summary: Overnight US index closes (S&P, Nasdaq, Dow) with change percents from Yahoo/CNBC with fallbacks.

nodes.name: indiaVix
nodes.summary: India VIX level and its 10 day percentile, the fear gauge check.

nodes.name: advanceDecline
nodes.summary: NIFTY 50 breadth: advancers vs decliners, the participation check.

nodes.name: giftNifty
nodes.summary: GIFT Nifty implied open scraped from TradingView; drives the readiness call.

nodes.name: frameworkVerdict
nodes.summary: Role based framework v2: weighs each check's role and state into the overall bias classification (Positive large to Negative large, Neutral or Conflicting).

nodes.name: toMarkdown
nodes.summary: Serializes the report to the plain markdown archive format.

nodes.name: ensembleView
nodes.summary: Blends TimesFM and the bias corrected LSTM with the learned weight and produces the forecast panel view.

nodes.name: updateScorecard
nodes.summary: Records each resolved forecast outcome and relearns the blend weight daily once at least 5 outcomes exist.

nodes.name: nextTradingDays
nodes.summary: Trading day calendar skipping weekends only, used for forecast horizons.

nodes.name: decodePackedModel
nodes.summary: Decodes the base64 packed weights (Little Endian float32) into layer matrices for inference.

nodes.name: LstmForecaster
nodes.summary: The recursive forecaster: warm starts with 49 real observations, predicts t+1, feeds predictions forward for the 5 session path.

nodes.name: LstmCell
nodes.summary: One LSTM cell step: input/forget/output gates with peephole free TF 1.6 semantics and clipped internal state.

nodes.name: runAdaptiveCycle
nodes.summary: One full learning cycle: pull new closes, resolve pending predictions, relearn per stock bias/band/blend, emit next forecasts.

nodes.name: newState
nodes.summary: Initializes per stock state including the VIX history the feature row needs (a past bug forgot it).

nodes.name: fetchNewRows
nodes.summary: Incremental Nasdaq quote API pulls with 1.1s pacing and newest-first row parsing.

nodes.name: runNewsCycle
nodes.summary: The whole 08:40 cycle: market and India headlines, 50 paced per symbol feeds, the earnings calendar, tags, heavy flags and history accounting.

nodes.name: parseRss
nodes.summary: Regex RSS/Atom parser extracting titles, links and dates without an XML dependency.

nodes.name: fetchEarnings
nodes.summary: Nasdaq earnings calendar walker for the next 10 weekdays with per request pacing.

nodes.name: tagHeadline
nodes.summary: Keyword matcher that tags headlines (rates, earnings, geopolitics, guidance, accident) using the TAGS table.

nodes.name: featureRow
nodes.summary: Builds the 26 features (returns, RSI, vol regimes, VIX percentile) for one symbol and day.

nodes.name: gbmPredict
nodes.summary: Evaluates the exported LightGBM trees in JS with full precision thresholds; regression starts at 0.

nodes.name: loadReport
nodes.summary: Fetches /api/latest (or an archived date), renders every dashboard panel and wires glossary term links.

nodes.name: renderNews
nodes.summary: Renders the news panel: earnings chips with estimates, heavy news flags, US and India headline lists and the honest display-only note.

nodes.name: plainWords
nodes.summary: The one box a first time visitor reads: today's call in one sentence with the model number and its honest caveat.

nodes.name: linkGlossaryTerms
nodes.summary: Auto links known jargon phrases in rendered text to their glossary anchors.

nodes.name: initTheme
nodes.summary: Theme bootstrap and toggle with localStorage persistence and theme-color meta sync.

nodes.name: lineChart
nodes.summary: Multi series SVG line chart with axes, nice ticks, legend and the fixed Okabe-Ito palette.

nodes.name: loadLive
nodes.summary: Fetches /api/stocks and /api/news in parallel and renders the live table with the events column.

nodes.name: bindLiveSort
nodes.summary: Wires the sortable headers: click flips direction, re-renders tbody and thead and rebinds.

nodes.name: LstmForecaster
nodes.summary: Recursive 5 session forecaster around the ported cell stack.

nodes.name: LstmCell
nodes.summary: Single LSTM cell step with TF 1.6 gate semantics.

nodes.name: default handler
nodes.summary: The function entrypoint: guards, then runs the cycle and stores the result.

nodes.name: news-scan stub
nodes.summary: Scheduled 03:10 UTC (08:40 IST, Mon-Sat). Triggers news-background; also self throttles to one run per 10 minutes via the last-news-run blob so public re-triggers cannot force reruns.

nodes.name: post-open-scan stub
nodes.summary: Scheduled 03:50 UTC (09:20 IST, Mon-Fri). Triggers the post-open confirmation snapshot in scan-background with the post-open header.

nodes.name: scan-background worker
nodes.summary: The 15 minute budget worker for the daily scan and the post-open confirmation. Rejects headerless public POSTs (403), stores the report as JSON/markdown/HTML in blobs, updates the framework scorecard and computes the summary in memory to dodge blob read-after-write staleness.

nodes.name: stocks-adaptive-background worker
nodes.summary: Runs the per stock learning cycle: resolves pending predictions against real closes, relearns per stock parameters and emits the next session forecasts into the stocks-live blob. Same 30 minute public throttle pattern.

nodes.name: stocks-adaptive stub
nodes.summary: Scheduled 03:40 UTC (09:10 IST, Mon-Sat; Saturday catches the Friday US close). Triggers stocks-adaptive-background with a 10 minute stub guard.

nodes.name: Root local test
nodes.summary: Smoke test runner for the local function stack from the project root.

nodes.name: Model analysis builder
nodes.summary: Offline: learns the ensemble weight from the TimesFM and LSTM forecast histories and writes assets/model-analysis.json.

nodes.name: Search index builder
nodes.summary: Builds assets/search-index.json from the 7 content pages (tags stripped) plus the 95 glossary terms imported from the real module, so search covers the glossary with anchors. Run after any content change.

nodes.name: Exhibit builder
nodes.summary: Python: builds the HPQ validation exhibit data from the article dataset.

nodes.name: Model packer
nodes.summary: Python: reads the trained Keras LSTM weights and emits the base64 packed blob consumed by lib/model-nifty.mjs.

nodes.name: Adaptivity proof
nodes.summary: Replays the walk-forward with the adaptive layer on and off to measure the honest gain (+0.3 to +1.1 points) and band coverage (77.97 percent).

nodes.name: Offline data fetcher
nodes.summary: Python: pulls per stock history from Nasdaq, Yahoo and Alpha Vantage with fallbacks and paces requests; feeds the offline TimesFM runs.

nodes.name: Style auditor
nodes.summary: Audits all shipped text for em dashes, buzzwords and style rule violations with an allowlist for numbers, tickers and ISO dates.

nodes.name: Local end-to-end test
nodes.summary: Boots the functions locally with netlify dev style stubs and checks the report pipeline.

nodes.name: News engine test
nodes.summary: Runs one real news cycle locally against the live sources and asserts headline counts, symbol feed health and earnings parsing. The NEWS_ENGINE_OK gate.

nodes.name: Stocks engine test
nodes.summary: Simulates the adaptive cycle against a fake blob store and asserts prediction resolution and relearning.

nodes.name: TimesFM runner
nodes.summary: Python: batches the 50 symbols through TimesFM 2.5 offline and writes the forecast artifact.

nodes.name: LSTM validator
nodes.summary: Loads the packed NIFTY model, runs the 5 session forecast and compares against the recorded training-time outputs to prove the JS port is bit faithful.

nodes.name: storeReport
nodes.summary: Writes the report as JSON, markdown and HTML blobs for the archive, the API and the latest view.

nodes.name: postOpenConfirmation
nodes.summary: The 09:20 snapshot: what actually happened after the bell, merged into today's stored report.

nodes.name: summaryFrom
nodes.summary: Computes the summary in memory after storing, dodging the blob read-after-write staleness bug.

nodes.name: default handler
nodes.summary: The function entrypoint: guards, then runs the cycle and stores the result.

layers.name: Presentation layer
layers.description: The 9 HTML pages the user actually visits: dashboard, stocks, glossary, ELI5, model, methodology, privacy, search and the custom 404. Static markup plus progressive enhancement; every page works without JavaScript.

layers.name: Frontend logic and design system
layers.description: The browser JavaScript (app.js dashboard controller, per page viewers, chart builders, shared chrome) and the single design system stylesheet. Zero npm dependencies, zero frameworks, ES modules and plain SVG charts.

layers.name: Domain engines
layers.description: The heart: the pre-market scan engine with the role framework verdict, the adaptive ensemble, the LSTM runtime and packed weights, the per stock GBM feature math, the 50 symbol adaptive engine and the news and events engine.

layers.name: Serverless functions
layers.description: The 13 Netlify functions: 4 cron stubs that hand off within the 30 second schedule cap, 3 background workers with the real budgets and header guards, and 6 read APIs serving the blobs.

layers.name: Data artifacts
layers.description: Shipped JSON: decade backtest, HPQ validation data, TimesFM analysis and stock forecasts, the search index, the history seed and the exported GBM trees. All generated by tools, all versioned with the code.

layers.name: Build and test tooling
layers.description: The offline Python (model packing, data fetching, TimesFM runs) and Node tools (search index builder, style auditor, validators, adaptivity proof) plus the local test suites.

layers.name: Configuration and deployment
layers.description: netlify.toml with the 4 schedules and the security headers, the dev-only package.json and the skills lockfile.

layers.name: Documentation
layers.description: README, the point by point compliance ledger, llms.txt for AI crawlers, robots.txt and the sitemap.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Read the README first: what the site does every trading morning at 09:00 IST, the honest accuracy numbers and how every layer fits together.

tour.title: The Front Door: Today's Report
tour.description: Open the dashboard page, then its controller. This is what a visitor sees: the plain words summary, the framework bias, the checks, the forecast and the news panel.

tour.title: The Daily Scan Engine
tour.description: The heart of the report: the four checks (US indices, India VIX, breadth, GIFT Nifty), market context and the role based framework that turns them into one verdict.

tour.title: The Role Framework in Practice
tour.description: The compliance ledger documents every requirement from the original spec and how it was met, version by version. The methodology page says the same to end users.

tour.title: The LSTM Port
tour.description: A faithful TensorFlow 1.6 LSTMCell port running in JavaScript: packed weights, decode step and the recursive 5 session forecaster. The validator proves it reproduces training outputs.

tour.title: The Adaptive Ensemble
tour.description: TimesFM and the bias corrected LSTM blended by a weight that relearns daily from resolved outcomes. This is the primary forecast on the dashboard.

tour.title: The Per Stock Ecosystem
tour.description: The same learning idea extended to 50 symbols: features, the exported GBM trees, per stock state and the daily adaptive cycle.

tour.title: News and Events Layer
tour.description: The display-only reality layer: headlines, earnings calendars and event tags that influence markets but are kept out of the numbers, with honest copy.

tour.title: Schedules and Background Workers
tour.description: Why stubs and workers exist: scheduled functions get 30 seconds, background functions get 15 minutes. The four cron schedules live in netlify.toml; the guards prevent public abuse.

tour.title: The Read APIs
tour.description: Six thin endpoints serving the stored blobs to the pages. No database anywhere: blob storage plus in-memory caches.

tour.title: The Stocks Page
tour.description: The densest page: 50 live adaptive forecasts, sorting, filtering, the events column, the decade backtest and the offline TimesFM table.

tour.title: Understanding the Language
tour.description: The glossary dataset and its viewer: 95 terms with formal and plain definitions, cross linked from every page automatically.

tour.title: The Design System
tour.description: One stylesheet, token driven, light and dark, Okabe Ito chart colors, zero overflow at any width. The chart builders emit plain SVG.

tour.title: Tooling and Trust
tour.description: The offline tools that build every shipped artifact and the proofs: LSTM validation, adaptivity proof, style audit and the search index builder.
